facts.statement: The Double Member Discount Event was valid from September 1, 2010 at 11:59am PDT until September 8, 2010 at 11:59am PDT, and was limited to Members.
facts.quote: Double Member Discount Event valid from September 1st (at 11:59am PDT) to September 8th (at 11:59am PDT).

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A limited-time SOE news post announcing that the Member Discount on Station Cash Marketplace purchases was doubled from 10% to 20% for Members only. The event ran from September 1 to September 8, 2010 (times given in PDT). The exact posting date is not shown; the page says only 'Posted 3 days, 19 hours ago' relative to the capture date.
